info.title: Tallyhand API v1
info.description:
Tallyhand is a local-first time tracker + invoicing app for freelancers/contractors. This API lets AI agents (and scripts, and the `tally` CLI) drive it without a browser.

## Agent quickstart
1. **Enable the API**: set `TALLYHAND_API_TOKEN` on the server. Every request (except `/health` and `/openapi.json`) needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
2. **Typical flow**: create a client → create a project under it → log tasks (time entries) → create an invoice (optionally from unbilled work) → `POST /invoices/{id}/send` to mark it sent (this also marks the linked tasks/expenses billed) → `POST /invoices/{id}/paid` when money arrives.
3. **Recurring billing**: create a `recurring-schedule` (fixed monthly fee, or auto-sweep of unbilled work), then call `POST /scheduler/run` on a cron to generate draft invoices when due.

## Conventions
- **Dates/times** are millisecond epoch numbers (UTC). Where the schema says `dateMs`, you may also send an ISO-8601 string; the server coerces it.
- **Money**: invoice line items use decimal dollars (`rate`, `amount`); retainers use integer **cents** (`amountCents`). Watch the units.
- **Envelopes**: success is `{ "data": ... }`; lists add `"meta": { "limit", "nextCursor", "total" }`. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.
- **Pagination**: `?limit=` (default 50, max 200), `?cursor=` (opaque base64 token from `meta.nextCursor`; null = last page).
- **Idempotency**: send `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` on any POST. Retrying with the same key replays the stored response instead of executing twice. Always use it for creates in agentic loops.
- **No partial failure**: multi-step writes (invoice numbering, send/paid transitions, scheduler runs) are atomic server-side.
- **Timers**: there is no server-side 'open timer'. A timer is a client-side concept — create the task when it stops (see the CLI/MCP timer tools, which manage this for you).

servers.description: Same origin (the Tallyhand server serves its own API)

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Time entries — each belongs to a project

get.description: No auth. Returns { status: 'ok', version }. Use it to check the server is up before doing anything else.
No auth. Returns this exact spec as JSON. Fetch it when you need the precise schema for an operation.
Alphabetical by name. Archived clients are hidden unless `?includeArchived=true`.

post.description: The root of everything billable: projects belong to clients, invoices bill clients. Set `defaultRate` (dollars/hour) once and every task logged under this client's projects inherits it on invoices.

patch.description: Partial update — only send the fields you're changing. `updatedAt` is refreshed server-side.

delete.description: Hard delete. Prefer archiving (PATCH { archived: true }) — deleting orphans the client's projects/tasks/invoices, which keep existing but lose their parent.

get.description: Filter by `?clientId=`. `rateOverride` (dollars/hour) on a project beats the client's `defaultRate` when building invoice line items.

post.description: A project belongs to exactly one client. Tasks are logged against projects, never directly against clients.

delete.description: Hard delete. Prefer archiving. Tasks already logged under it are NOT deleted (they become orphaned).

get.description: Newest first. Filter by `?projectId=`, `?clientId=`, `?isBilled=true|false`. The `?isBilled=false` view is your 'uninvoiced work' queue — the input to invoice drafting.

post.description: Creates one task. `durationMinutes` is derived from `startAt`/`endAt` when omitted — prefer sending both timestamps and letting the server compute it. `endAt` must be >= `startAt`. There is no server-side running timer: when a timer stops, POST the completed entry.

patch.description: Partial update. Changing `startAt`/`endAt` recomputes `durationMinutes` server-side. Do not hand-edit `isBilled`/`invoiceId` to bill work — use the invoice send flow so books stay consistent.

post.description: `amount` is in dollars (>= 0). Attach to a client, a project, or neither (unattached expenses can still be added to invoices manually).

get.description: Newest first. Filter by `?clientId=` and `?status=draft|sent|paid`. `?status=draft` is your review queue; `?status=sent` is your outstanding receivables.

post.description: Creates an invoice (default `draft`). The server fills in what you omit: `invoiceNumber` (atomic sequential numbering), `subtotal`/`total` (from line items), line-item `id`/`amount`, and `publicToken`. To link entries, set `sourceType: 'task'|'expense'` + `sourceId` on a line item — `POST /invoices/{id}/send` then marks those entries billed. Gotcha: creating the invoice does NOT mark anything billed; only sending does.

patch.description: Partial update. If you replace `lineItems` without sending `subtotal`/`total`, the server recomputes them. Prefer the dedicated send/paid endpoints for status transitions.

delete.description: Hard delete. Note: tasks/expenses already marked billed by this invoice stay billed — un-bill them manually if you void an invoice.

post.description: The billing moment: flips status to `sent` and marks every task/expense linked via line items as billed (with this invoice's id). Atomic and idempotent — retry freely; already-sent invoices are a no-op success.
Flips status to `paid`. Idempotent — retry freely. There is no partial-payment model; an invoice is either outstanding or paid.

get.description: Ordered by next run time (soonest first). Filter by `?clientId=` and `?status=active|paused|ended`.

post.description: Two modes: `fixed` bills the same `lineItems` every run (e.g. a $2,000/mo retainer fee — needs at least one line item); `unbilled` sweeps the client's (optionally one project's) unbilled tasks+expenses into an invoice each run and skips empty runs. `nextRunAt` defaults to `startDate`. Frequency math: weekly = 7d × interval; monthly/quarterly/yearly = calendar months (×1/×3/×12 interval) clamped to month-end (Jan 31 → Feb 28).

patch.description: Partial update. Use `{ status: 'paused' }` to pause billing without deleting the schedule, `{ status: 'active' }` to resume. You can also reschedule by setting `nextRunAt` directly.

delete.description: Stops future runs. Invoices already generated are untouched.

post.description: Generates a draft invoice from this schedule immediately — even if it isn't due, even if paused. Counts as an occurrence and advances `nextRunAt`. Use it to bill a client early or to test a schedule. Returns the run result: `{ scheduleId, invoiceId (null when the run found nothing billable), skipped, nextRunAt, occurrences, status }`.

The automation hook: finds every `active` schedule with `nextRunAt <= now`, generates a draft invoice per schedule, and advances them. Schedules far past due advance to the next future slot without generating an invoice per missed slot (no back-billing spam). Empty `unbilled` runs are skipped but still count as occurrences. Designed for cron — run it hourly/daily; re-running is safe because schedules advance past due slots. Returns `{ generated: [invoiceIds], results: [per-schedule results] }`.

get.description: Filter by `?clientId=` and `?status=active|paused|depleted|ended`. A retainer is an agreement wrapper: `prepaid-hours` (client pre-buys N hours; track drawdown yourself via tasks) or `monthly-fee` (usually paired with a recurring schedule via `recurringScheduleId`).

post.description: `amountCents` is integer cents (watch the units — unlike invoices). `prepaid-hours` requires `totalHours`. For `monthly-fee`, create the retainer first, then a `fixed` recurring schedule, then PATCH the retainer with `recurringScheduleId` to link them.

get.description: The singleton settings: business profile (name, email, payment instructions shown on invoices), invoice prefs (number prefix, next number, payment terms days), reckoning config, expense categories, appearance.

patch.description: Deep-partial update: nested objects (`business`, `invoice`, …) merge key-wise, so PATCH `{ invoice: { paymentTermsDays: 30 } }` changes only that field. Useful setup call: set your business name, email, and payment instructions once.

bearerAuth.description: Shared API token. Set TALLYHAND_API_TOKEN on the server, then send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque base64 page token from a previous response's meta.nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Entity id (e.g. cli_..., prj_..., tsk_..., inv_...)

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. a UUID). Retrying a POST with the same key replays the stored response instead of executing twice. Strongly recommended for all creates in agentic loops.

ApiDisabled.description: TALLYHAND_API_TOKEN is not set on the server

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page

DateMs.description: Millisecond epoch (UTC), or an ISO-8601 date string — the server coerces strings to ms

defaultRate.description: Dollars/hour inherited by invoice line items

rateOverride.description: Dollars/hour; beats the client's defaultRate on invoices

durationMinutes.description: Derived from startAt/endAt when omitted on create

isBilled.description: True once claimed by an invoice — do not hand-edit; use the invoice send flow

sourceId.description: Task/expense id this line bills — set on send to mark it billed

publicToken.description: Token for the public read-only invoice link

invoiceNumber.description: Omit for the next atomic sequential number

subtotal.description: Omit — server computes from line items

total.description: Omit — server computes from line items

projectId.description: Scope unbilled sweeps to one project (unbilled mode)

mode.description: fixed = bill lineItems every run; unbilled = sweep unbilled tasks+expenses each run

nextRunAt.description: Ms epoch of the next scheduled run

invoiceId.description: Draft invoice created, or null when the run found nothing billable

skipped.description: 'empty' when an unbilled-mode run found nothing to bill

generated.description: Ids of draft invoices created by this run

totalHours.description: Required for prepaid-hours: the hour block the client bought

paymentInstructions.description: Shown on invoices — set this so clients know how to pay

paymentTermsDays.description: Due date = issue date + this many days

ClientPatch.description: Partial client update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

ProjectPatch.description: Partial project update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

TaskPatch.description: Partial task update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

ExpensePatch.description: Partial expense update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

InvoicePatch.description: Partial invoice update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

invoiceNumber.description: Omit for the next atomic sequential number

subtotal.description: Omit — server computes from line items

total.description: Omit — server computes from line items

RecurringSchedulePatch.description: Partial recurring schedule update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.

RetainerPatch.description: Partial retainer update — every field is optional; only the fields you send are changed.
